selection: All 100 saved validation queries, 50 per class. Previously inspected development data, not held-out confirmation.
baseline: CF2 binary-link adaptation with exact-boundary-local objective evaluation and authoritative full-original-graph support metrics.
backend_evidence: CPU/GPU soft-mask objective and gradient tests plus four complete 2000-step paired full/local runs. No claim that all floating-point optimizer trajectories coincide. Keep local-backend identity explicit.
evaluation: Independently replay all 900 reference supports and compute all 300 CF2 supports using original weights, undirected retention/deletion and raw-logit zero threshold.
comparison_scope: Same queries and checkpoint as gnnexplainer_PubMed43_val100.json, allowing paired quality comparison after hash and query checks. Existing timing measurements are not controlled cross-method runtime comparisons.
decision: Evaluate necessity and sufficiency jointly, preserve all outcomes, and do not promote coarsening based on an advantage shared by ungrouped search. No tuning on test data or empirical LaTeX updates.
